title: The End of an Architectural Era (It's Time for a Complete Rewrite)
authors: Michael Stonebraker, Samuel Madden, Daniel J. Abadi, Stavros Harizopoulos, Nabil Hachem, Pat Helland
description: Argues that 25-year-old RDBMS architectures are fundamentally obsolete for OLTP and presents H-Store, a main-memory, single-threaded, shared-nothing prototype that runs TPC-C 82 times faster than a commercial RDBMS by eliminating logging, locking, and buffer management overhead.
